description: Declared mutants of the JSON Module batch (docs/architecture/target/v2/json-module-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 8.6; ids js- reading and numbers, jw- writing, jb- build-time link and header checks, jg- the J-1 guard script). Written step by step with the tests; the adversarial check of the whole catalog (Fable/high, 2026-11-20; build/evidence/gyo2-json-module/mutation-check-fable/) found 38 implementation changes and 6 guard changes no mutant caught, 3 defects (D1-D3, fixed), and expects that did not single out their mutant: the tests and mutants it asked for are added, the expects narrowed. Not added (with the reason): the depth check in EndContainer (equivalent: Top() asserts the same); the std::bad_alloc catch in NumberText (equivalent: its only caller, WriteValue, catches at its own boundary since D1); the empty-text check before yyjson (equivalent: yyjson reports empty input as an error at offset 0 too); a move constructor that does not empty its source (undefined behaviour, a double free); the "finished" checks in BeforeValue, Key and EndContainer (equivalent under test: after Finish the depth and top-level checks fail as well); !isfinite -> isnan in Double (killed only by WriteDouble's assertion aborting); messages no test reads (integer range detail, number message); J-9's linearity in time (no reliable test without timing: guarded by review and the size cases); reading-method mutants of the guard (comment and string blanking: added only after an observed miss, per the criteria).
